name: diag_diff_lossless_archive_01
command:
import gzip,hashlib,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
files=[]
for p in sorted(Path('logs/runs').glob('*.diff')):
 if p.stat().st_size<=50*1024*1024: continue
 target=Path(str(p)+'.gz')
 before=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if not target.exists():
  with p.open('rb') as r,target.open('xb') as w:
   with gzip.GzipFile(filename='',mode='wb',fileobj=w,mtime=0,compresslevel=1) as z: shutil.copyfileobj(r,z,1024*1024)
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with gzip.open(target,'rb') as r:
  for chunk in iter(lambda:r.read(1024*1024),b''): h.update(chunk)
 assert before==h.hexdigest()
 assert target.stat().st_size<=50*1024*1024
 files.append(dict(source=str(p),source_bytes=p.stat().st_size,source_sha256=before,archive=str(target),archive_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),archive_bytes=target.stat().st_size,roundtrip_verified=True))
out=Path('logs/review/diag_diff_lossless_archive_01');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'format':'gzip-whole-file-v1','files':files,'restoration':'gzip -dc <archive> > <source>; verify source_sha256 before audit; original source remains unchanged on Hopper'},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(files))
